47: #define AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE 256
48: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX 3
49: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS  10
50: #define AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS  50
51: 
52: static beken_semaphore_t s_ap_uart0_log_sem;
53: static beken_thread_t s_ap_uart0_log_thread;
54: static volatile uint32_t s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail;

56: static void ap_uart0_log_output(const uint8_t *line, u16 length)
57: {
58: 	static const uint8_t prefix[] = "ap0: ";
59: 	uint8_t output[sizeof(prefix) - 1 + AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
60: 	u16 output_length;
61: 	u8 retry;
62: 
63: 	memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
64: 	memcpy(output + sizeof(prefix) - 1, line, length);
65: 	output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1 + length;
66: 
67: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
68: 	{
69: 		if (shell_log_raw_data(output, output_length))
70: 		{
71: 			return;
72: 		}
73: 
74: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS);
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
78: }
79: 
80: static void ap_uart0_log_rx(void *param)
81: {
82: 	(void)param;
83: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
84: }
85: 
86: static void ap_uart0_log_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
87: {
88: 	uint8_t input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
89: 	uint8_t line[AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
90: 	u16 line_length = 0;
91: 
92: 	(void)arg;
93: 	for (;;)
94: 	{
95: 		u16 input_length;
96: 		u16 index;
97: 		bk_err_t ret;
98: 
99: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem,
100: 						 line_length ? AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS : BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
101: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr)
102: 		{
103: 			ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
104: 			line_length = 0;
105: 			continue;
106: 		}
107: 
108: 		do
109: 		{
110: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
111: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
112: 			{
113: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
114: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
115: 				{
116: 					ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
117: 					line_length = 0;
118: 				}
119: 			}
120: 		} while (input_length != 0);
121: 	}
122: }
123: 
124: static bk_err_t ap_uart0_log_init(void)
125: {
126: 	bk_err_t ret;
127: 
128: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, 1);
129: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
130: 	{
131: 		return ret;
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread,
135: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
136: 					 "ap_uart0_log", ap_uart0_log_task, 2048, NULL);
137: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
138: 	{
139: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
140: 		return ret;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
144: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
145: 	{
146: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
147: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
148: 		return ret;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL);
152: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
153: 	{
154: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
155: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
156: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
157: 		return ret;
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	/* Drain data that may have arrived between channel open and callback
161: 	 * registration. The binary semaphore intentionally coalesces wakeups. */
162: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
163: 	return BK_OK;
164: }
165: #endif

287: 		cpy_len = buf_len;
288: 		
289: 		if((buf_len + 1) > mb_ext->tx_sync_len)
290: 		{
291: 			cpy_len = mb_ext->tx_sync_len - 1;
292: 		}
293: 
294: 		buff_busy = (volatile u8 * )&tx_buff[0];
295: 		tx_buff[0] = 1;  /* the buffer is busy. */
296: 		memcpy(&tx_buff[1], p_buf, cpy_len);
297: 
298: 		mb_chnl_cmd_t	mb_cmd_buf;
299: 		log_cmd_t * cmd_buf = (log_cmd_t *)&mb_cmd_buf;
300: 
301: 		cmd_buf->hdr.data = 0;
302: 		cmd_buf->hdr.cmd = MB_CMD_ASSERT_OUT;
303: 		cmd_buf->buf = tx_buff;
304: 		cmd_buf->len = cpy_len + 1;
305: 		cmd_buf->tag = 0xFFFF;		/* tx_buff is not dynamically allocated memory. */
306: 
307: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_ctrl(mb_ext->chnl_id, MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC, &mb_cmd_buf);
308: 
309: 		if(ret_code == BK_OK)
310: 		{
311: 			while(*buff_busy)
312: 			{
313: 				/* wait buffer to be free (*buff_busy == 0). */
314: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
315: 				flush_dcache((void *)buff_busy, 1);
316: 				#endif
317: 			}
318: 		}
319: 		else
320: 		{
321: 			break;
322: 		}
323: 
324: 		buf_len -= cpy_len;
325: 		p_buf += cpy_len;
326: 
327: 	};
328: 
329: 	return ret_code;
330: }

332: static void shell_mb_flush(shell_mb_ext_t *mb_ext)
333: {
334: 	if(mb_ext->tx_stopped == 0)
335: 	{
336: 		if((mb_ext->cur_packet != NULL) && (mb_ext->tx_complete_callback != NULL))
337: 		{
338: 			mb_ext->tx_complete_callback(mb_ext->cur_packet, mb_ext->packet_tag);
339: 		}
340: 	}
341: 	
342: 	while(mb_ext->tx_stopped == 0)
343: 	{
344: 		/* next tx. */
345: 		if(mb_ext->list_out_idx != mb_ext->list_in_idx)
346: 		{
347: 			mb_ext->cur_packet = mb_ext->tx_list[mb_ext->list_out_idx].packet;
348: 			mb_ext->packet_len = mb_ext->tx_list[mb_ext->list_out_idx].len;
349: 			mb_ext->packet_tag = mb_ext->tx_list[mb_ext->list_out_idx].tag;
350: 
351: 			write_sync(mb_ext, mb_ext->cur_packet, mb_ext->packet_len);
352: 
353: 			/* to next packet. */
354: 			mb_ext->list_out_idx = (mb_ext->list_out_idx + 1) % TX_QUEUE_LEN;
355: 		}
356: 		else
357: 		{
358: 			/* all packets tx complete. */
359: 
360: 			mb_ext->cur_packet = NULL;
361: 			mb_ext->packet_len = 0;
362: 
363: 			mb_ext->tx_stopped = 1; /* bTRUE;*/  /* all data tranferred, tx stopped.*/
364: 
365: 			continue;
366: 		}
367: 
368: 		/* MB_CMD_LOG_OUT tx complete. */
369: 
370: 		// must have handled complete, because of using MB_CMD_ASSERT_OUT.
371: 		{
372: 			/* MB_CMD_LOG_OUT handle complete. */
373: 			/* so notify app to free buffer. */
374: 			if(mb_ext->tx_complete_callback != NULL)
375: 			{
376: 				mb_ext->tx_complete_callback(mb_ext->cur_packet, mb_ext->packet_tag);
377: 			}
378: 		}
379: 	}
380: }

66: {

146: static void shell_uart_rx_isr(int uartn, shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
147: {
148: 	u16   free_buff_len, rx_cnt = 0;
149: 	u8    rx_data;
150: 	int   ret = -1;
151: 
152: 	(void)uartn;
153: 
154: 	if(uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx >= uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx)
155: 	{
156: 	    free_buff_len = RX_BUFF_SIZE - uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx + uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx;
157: 	}
158: 	else
159: 	{
160: 		free_buff_len = uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx - uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx;
161: 	}
162: 
163: 	while(bTRUE)  /* read all data from rx-FIFO. */
164: 	{
165: 		ret = uart_read_byte_ex(uart_ext->uart_id, &rx_data);
166: 		if (ret == -1)
167: 			break;
168: 
169: 		rx_cnt++;
170: 
171: 		/* rx_buff_wr_idx == rx_buff_rd_idx means empty, so reserve one byte. */
172: 		if(rx_cnt < free_buff_len)  /* reserved one byte space. */
173: 		{
174: 			uart_ext->rx_buff[uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx] = rx_data;
175: 
176: 			uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx = (uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx + 1) % RX_BUFF_SIZE;
177: 
178: 		}
179: 		else
180: 		{
181: 			/* discard rx-data, rx overflow. */
182: 			uart_ext->rx_over_flow = 1; //  bTRUE; // rx overflow, disable rx interrupt to stop rx.
183: 		}
184: 	}
185: 
186: 	if(uart_ext->rx_indicate_callback != NULL)
187: 	{
188: 		uart_ext->rx_indicate_callback();
189: 	}
190: }

192: static void shell_uart_tx_isr(int uartn, shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
193: {
194: 	int   ret;
195: 	(void)uartn;
196: 
197: 	while(bTRUE)  /* write data to tx-FIFO. */
198: 	{
199: 		ret = uart_write_ready(uart_ext->uart_id);
200: 		if(ret != 0)
201: 			break;
202: 
203: 		/* previous packet tx complete, check ECHO before new packet. */
204: 		if((uart_ext->cur_packet == NULL) || (uart_ext->packet_len == 0))
205: 		{
206: 			if(uart_ext->echo_rd_idx != uart_ext->echo_wr_idx) /* tx echo firstly. */
207: 			{
208: 				uart_write_byte(uart_ext->uart_id, uart_ext->echo_buff[uart_ext->echo_rd_idx]);
209: 
210: 				uart_ext->echo_rd_idx = (uart_ext->echo_rd_idx + 1) % ECHO_BUFF_SIZE;
211: 
212: 				continue;  /* continue to ECHO next byte to tx-FIFO. */
213: 			}
214: 			else
215: 			{
216: 				if(uart_ext->list_out_idx != uart_ext->list_in_idx)
217: 				{
218: 					uart_ext->cur_packet = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].packet;
219: 					uart_ext->packet_len = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].len;
220: 					uart_ext->packet_tag = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].tag;
221: 					uart_ext->packet_tx_len = 0;
222: 				}
223: 				else
224: 				{
225: 					/* all packets tx complete. */
226: 					/* disable tx interrupt ? */  // disable TX firstly, then set tx_stopped to 1.
227: 					bk_uart_disable_tx_interrupt(uart_ext->uart_id);
228: 
229: 					uart_ext->tx_stopped = 1; /* bTRUE;*/  /* all data tranferred, tx stopped.*/
230: 					break;
231: 				}
232: 			}
233: 		}
234: 
235: 		if(uart_ext->packet_tx_len < uart_ext->packet_len)
236: 		{
237: 			uart_write_byte(uart_ext->uart_id, uart_ext->cur_packet[uart_ext->packet_tx_len]);
238: 
239: 			uart_ext->packet_tx_len++;
240: 
241: 			continue;  /* continue to TX next byte to tx-FIFO. */
242: 		}
243: 		else
244: 		{
245: 			/* sent the whole packet, notify app. */
246: 			if(uart_ext->tx_complete_callback != NULL)
247: 			{
248: 				uart_ext->tx_complete_callback(uart_ext->cur_packet, uart_ext->packet_tag);
249: 			}
250: 
251: 			uart_ext->cur_packet = NULL;
252: 			uart_ext->packet_len = 0;
253: 			uart_ext->packet_tx_len = 0;
254: 
255: 			/* to next packet. */
256: 			uart_ext->list_out_idx = (uart_ext->list_out_idx + 1) % TX_QUEUE_LEN;
257: 
258: 			continue;   /* continue to TX next packet. */
259: 		}
260: 	}
261: 
262: }

264: static void shell_uart_tx_trigger(shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
265: {
266: 	if(uart_ext->tx_suspend != 0)

273: 
274: 	bk_uart_enable_tx_interrupt(uart_ext->uart_id);

277: static void shell_uart_flush(shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
278: {
279: 	int   ret;
280: 
281: 	if(uart_ext->tx_suspend != 0)
282: 	{
283: 		// resume tx.....
284: 		uart_ext->tx_suspend = 0;
285: 		shell_uart_tx_trigger(uart_ext);
286: 	}
287: 
288: 	while(uart_ext->tx_stopped == 0) /* log tx pending. */
289: 	{
290: 		ret = uart_write_ready(uart_ext->uart_id);
291: 		if(ret == BK_OK)
292: 		{

294: 		}

356: static u16 shell_uart_write_async(shell_dev_t * shell_dev, u8 * pBuf, u16 BufLen, u16 Tag)
357: {
358: 	u16   free_items;
359: 	shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext;
360: 
361: 	if(shell_dev == NULL)
362: 		return 0;
363: 
364: 	uart_ext = (shell_uart_ext_t *)shell_dev->dev_ext;
365: 
366: 	if((pBuf == NULL) /*|| (BufLen == 0)*/)
367: 		return 0;
368: 
369: 	/* enqueue pBuf even if BufLen is 0, upper layer need tx-complete-callback to free this pBuf. */
370: 
371: 	if(uart_ext->list_out_idx > uart_ext->list_in_idx)
372: 		free_items = uart_ext->list_out_idx - uart_ext->list_in_idx;
373: 	else
374: 		free_items = TX_QUEUE_LEN - uart_ext->list_in_idx + uart_ext->list_out_idx;
375: 
376: 	/* list_out_idx == list_in_idx means empty, so reserved one item. */
377: 	if(free_items > 1)
378: 	{
379: 		uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_in_idx].packet = pBuf;
380: 		uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_in_idx].len  = BufLen;
381: 		uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_in_idx].tag  = Tag;
382: 
383: 		uart_ext->list_in_idx = (uart_ext->list_in_idx + 1) % TX_QUEUE_LEN;
384: 
385: 		shell_uart_tx_trigger(uart_ext);
386: 
387: 		return 1;
388: 	}
389: 	else
390: 	{
391: 		return 0;
392: 	}
393: }

522: 			free_blk_id = free_q->blk_list[free_q->list_out_idx];
523: 
524: 			// free_q->list_out_idx = (free_q->list_out_idx + 1) % free_q->blk_num;
525: 			if((free_q->list_out_idx + 1) < free_q->blk_num)
526: 				free_q->list_out_idx++;
527: 			else
528: 				free_q->list_out_idx = 0;
529: 
530: 			free_q->free_blk_num--;
531: 
532: 			blk_buf = &free_q->log_buf[free_blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
533: 			*blk_tag = MAKE_BLOCK_TAG(free_blk_id, queue_id);
534: 
535: 			break;
536: 		}
537: 		else
538: 		{
539: 			if(ovf_cnt_saved == 0)
540: 			{
541: 				free_q->ovf_cnt++;
542: 				ovf_cnt_saved = 1;
543: 			}
544: 		}
545: 	}
546: 
547: 	if(blk_buf == NULL)
548: 	{
549: 		shell_log_overflow++;
550: 	}
551: 	else
552: 	{
553: 		fault_hint_print = 0;
554: 		shell_log_count++;
555: 	}
556: 
557: 	shell_task_exit_critical(int_mask);
558: 
559: 	return blk_buf;
560: }

593: static int merge_log_data(u16 blk_tag, u16 data_len)
594: {
595: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
596: 	{
597: 		return 0;
598: 	}
599: 
600: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(blk_tag);
601: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(blk_tag);
602: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
603: 	{
604: 		return 0;
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
608: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
609: 
610: 	u8		* src_buf = NULL;
611: 
612: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
613: 	{
614: 		src_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
615: 	}
616: 	else
617: 		return 0;
618: 
619: 	u16    pre_in_idx;
620: 
621: 	if(pending_queue.list_in_idx > 0)
622: 		pre_in_idx = pending_queue.list_in_idx - 1;
623: 	else
624: 		pre_in_idx = SHELL_LOG_PEND_NUM - 1;
625: 
626: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
627: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
628: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
629: 	{
630: 		return 0;
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	u8		* dst_buf = NULL;
634: 	u16       buf_len = 0;
635: 
636: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
637: 
638: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
639: 	{
640: 		dst_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
641: 		buf_len = free_q->blk_len;
642: 	}
643: 	else
644: 		return 0;
645: 
646: 	u16       cur_len = pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len;
647: 
648: 	if((cur_len + data_len) > buf_len)  /* can be merged into one buffer? */
649: 		return 0;
650: 
651: 	memcpy(dst_buf + cur_len, src_buf, data_len);
652: 
653: 	pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len += data_len;
654: 
655: 	free_log_blk(blk_tag);  /* merged, free the log buffer. */
656: 
657: 	return 1;
658: }

699: /* call from cmd TX ISR. */
700: static int cmd_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
701: {
702: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
703: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
704: 
705: 	/* rsp ok ?? */
706: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID )    /* rsp. */
707: 	{
708: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
709: 
710: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
711: 		{
712: 			/* something wrong!!! */
713: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: in rsp.\r\n");
714: 		}
715: 
716: 		/* rsp compelete, rsp_buff can be used for next cmd/response. */
717: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.rsp_buf_semaphore);
718: 
719: 		return 1;
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID )    /* cmd_ind. */
723: 	{
724: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
725: 
726: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
727: 		{
728: 			/* something wrong!!! */
729: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: indication.\r\n");
730: 		}
731: 
732: 		/* indication tx compelete, cmd_ind_buff can be used for next cmd_indication. */
733: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.ind_buf_semaphore);
734: 
735: 		return 1;
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
739: 	{
740: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
741: 
742: 		if (blk_id == 1)
743: 		{
744: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str)
745: 			{
746: 				/* something wrong!!! */
747: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
748: 			}
749: 
750: 			cmd_line_buf.cmd_ovf_hint = 0;
751: 
752: 			return 1;
753: 		}
754: 	}
755: 
756: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_FWD_QUEUE_ID )    /* slave buffer. */
757: 	{
758: 		#if defined(FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX)
759: 		if (log_handle_init_ok) {
760: 			set_fwd_state(blk_id);
761: 		} else {
762: 			result_fwd(blk_id);
763: 		}
764: 		return 1;
765: 		#endif
766: 	}
767: 
768: 	return 0;
769: }

785: /* call from log TX ISR. */
786: static int log_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
787: {
788: 	u16     block_tag;
789: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
790: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
791: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
792: 
793: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
794: 	{
795: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
796: 
797: 		if (blk_id == 0)
798: 		{
799: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_fault_str)
800: 			{
801: 				/* something wrong!!! */
802: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
803: 			}
804: 
805: 			return 1;
806: 		}
807: 	}
808: 
809: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))   /* from log busy queue. */
810: 	{
811: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
812: 
813: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
814: 
815: 		block_tag = log_busy_queue.blk_list[log_busy_queue.list_out_idx];
816: 
817: 		if( ( buf_tag != block_tag ) || (blk_id >= free_q->blk_num) ||
818: 			( (&free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len]) != pbuf) )
819: 		{
820: 			/* something wrong!!! */
821: 			/*        FAULT !!!!      */
822: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:%x,%x\r\n", buf_tag, block_tag);
823: 
824: 			return -1;
825: 		}
826: 
827: 		/* de-queue from busy queue. */
828: 		//log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = (log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) % SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM;
829: 		if((log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) < SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM)
830: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx++;
831: 		else
832: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = 0;
833: 
834: 		log_busy_queue.free_cnt++;
835: 
836: 		/* free buffer to queue. */
837: 		free_log_blk(block_tag);
838: 
839: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL) {
840: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&log_buf_semaphore);
841: 		}
842: 
843: 		return 1;
844: 	}
845: 
846: 	if (queue_id == SHELL_DYM_QUEUE_ID) {
847: 		dynamic_log_node *node = dynamic_list_pop_front();
848: 		free_list_push_front(node);
849: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL)
850: 			set_shell_event(&shell_log_event, SHELL_EVENT_DYM_FREE);
851: 		return 1;
852: 	}
853: 	return 0;
854: }

1028: /* call this in interrupt !* DISABLED *! context. */
1029: static void tx_req_process(void)
1030: {
1031: 	u8		*packet_buf = NULL;
1032: 	u16		block_tag;
1033: 	u16		log_len;
1034: 	u16		tx_ready;
1035: 	u16		blk_id;
1036: 	u8		queue_id;
1037: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
1038: 
1039: 	/* maybe tx_req is from tx_complete_callback, check if there any log in queue. */
1040: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
1041: 		return;
1042: 
1043: 	if(log_busy_queue.free_cnt == 0)
1044: 		return;
1045: 	
1046: 	tx_ready = 0;
1047: 
1048: 	log_dev->dev_drv->io_ctrl(log_dev, SHELL_IO_CTRL_GET_STATUS, &tx_ready);
1049: 
1050: 	if(tx_ready == 0)
1051: 		return;
1052: 
1053: 	/**    ====     POP from pending queue     ====    **/
1054: 	pull_pending_queue(&block_tag, &log_len);
1055: 
1056: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(block_tag);
1057: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(block_tag);
1058: 
1059: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
1060: 	{
1061: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
1062: 
1063: 		if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
1064: 		{
1065: 			packet_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
1066: 		}
1067: 	}
1068: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID)
1069: 	{
1070: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff;
1071: 
1072: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1073: 		{
1074: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1075: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1076: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1077: 			 * rsp will not be pushed into pending queue.
1078: 			 */
1079: 		}
1080: 	}
1081: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID)
1082: 	{
1083: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff;
1084: 
1085: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1086: 		{
1087: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1088: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1089: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1090: 			 * indication will not be pushed into pending queue.
1091: 			 */
1092: 		}
1093: 	}
1094: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID)
1095: 	{
1096: 		if(blk_id == 0)
1097: 		{

137: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
138: {
139: 	u8    crc = 0x00;
140: 
141: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE
142: 	for (u16 i = 0; i < len; i++)
143: 	{
144: 		crc = crc8_table[crc ^ data_buf[i]];
145: 	}
146: #endif
147: 
148: 	return (crc);
149: }

179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}
264: 
265: rx_isr_data_xit:
266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
268: 	{
269: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
273: 
274: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
275: 
276: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
277: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
278: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
279: 	 */
280: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
281: 
282: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
285: 
286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
287: 	{
288: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
289: 		{
290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

326: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
327: {
328: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
329: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
330: 	
331: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
332: 	{
333: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
334: 	}
335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;
353: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
541: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
543: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
544: 
545: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
546: 
547: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;
553: }

571: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
572: 
573: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
574: 	{
575: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
576: 	}
577: 
578: 	return ret_val;

628: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
629: {
630: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
631: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
632: 	
633: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
634: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
635: 
636: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
637: 	{
638: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
643: 	}
644: 
645: 	wr_len = data_len;
646: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
647: 		wr_len = rem_len;
648: 
649: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
650: 	{
651: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
652: 	}
653: 	else
654: 	{
655: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
656: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
657: 
658: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
659: 		{
660: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
661: 		}
662: 		else
663: 		{
664: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
665: 
666: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
671: 
672: 	/* trigger send! */
673: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
674: 
675: 	return wr_len;
676: }

678: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
679: {
680: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
681: 
682: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
683: 		return 0;
684: 
685: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
686: 
687: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
688: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
689: 
690: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
691: 	{
692: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
693: 	}
694: 	else
695: 	{
696: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
700: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
701: 		rd_len = buf_len;
702: 
703: 	if(rd_len == 0)
704: 	{
705: 		return 0;
706: 	}
707: 
708: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
709: 	{
710: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
711: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
712: 	}
713: 	else
714: 	{
715: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
716: 
717: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
718: 		{
719: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
720: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
721: 		}
722: 		else
723: 		{
724: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
725: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
726: 			{
727: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
728: 			}
729: 
730: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
731: 		}
732: 	}
733: 
734: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
735: 
736: 	/* rts assert...... */
737: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
738: 	{
739: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
740: 		{
741: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
742: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
743: 		}
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	return rd_len;
747: 
748: }

436:        * registered receiver still gets a COM_FAIL transport ACK. Returning
437:        * without the ACK leaves CP's physical channel BUSY and blocks higher
438:        * priority PWC responses queued behind this message.
439:        */

441:       g_stats.unsupported_channel++;
442:       g_stats.last_bad_channel = logical_channel;
443:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
444:     }

636: int bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, uint16_t length)
637: {
638:   irqstate_t flags;
639:   uint16_t written = 0;
640: 
641:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
642:     {
643:       return -EINVAL;
644:     }
645: 
646:   flags = up_irq_save();
647:   {
648:     uint16_t free_space;
649:     uint16_t first;
650: 
651:     if (g_uart_write >= g_uart_read)
652:       {
653:         free_space = UART_TX_SIZE - (g_uart_write - g_uart_read) - 1u;
654:       }
655:     else
656:       {
657:         free_space = g_uart_read - g_uart_write - 1u;
658:       }
659: 
660:     if (length < free_space)
661:       {
662:         written = length;
663:       }
664:     else
665:       {
666:         written = free_space;
667:       }
668: 
669:     first = UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart_write;
670:     if (first > written)
671:       {
672:         first = written;
673:       }
674: 
675:     memcpy(&g_uart_tx[g_uart_write], data, first);
676:     if (first < written)
677:       {
678:         memcpy(g_uart_tx, data + first, written - first);
679:       }
680: 
681:     g_uart_write = (g_uart_write + written) % UART_TX_SIZE;
682:     g_stats.uart_write_calls++;
683:     g_stats.uart_write_bytes += written;
684: 
685:     if (written < length)
686:       {
687:         g_stats.uart_drop += length - written;
688:         g_stats.uart_drop_events++;
689:       }
690:   }
691: 
692:   if (g_initialized)
693:     {
694:       uart_prepare();
695:       (void)dispatch_locked();
696:     }
697:   up_irq_restore(flags);
698:   if (g_initialized)
699:     {
700:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
701:     }
702:   return written == length ? OK : -ENOSPC;
703: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: #include <string.h>
9: 
10: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
11: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
12: #include <sys/param.h>
13: #include "arm_internal.h"
14: 
15: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
17: #include "irq.h"
18: 
19: #define MBOX_REG(n) (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
20: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG MBOX_REG(0x20)
21: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG MBOX_REG(0x21)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x22)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x23)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TID MBOX_REG(0x24)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_SID MBOX_REG(0x25)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x26)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x27)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x28)
29: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x18)
30: #define MBOX_CTRL MBOX_REG(2)
31: #define MBOX_INT_STATUS MBOX_REG(3)
32: 
33: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
34: static bool g_mbox_ready;
35: 
36: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
37: {
38:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
39: }
40: 
41: int bk7258_mbox_receive(bk7258_mbox_message_t *message)
42: {
43:   if (message == NULL || (bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) != 0)
44:     {
45:       return -EINVAL;
46:     }
47: 
48:   message->src_cpu = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0xfu;
49:   message->data[0] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
50:   message->data[1] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
51:   return OK;
52: }
53: 
54: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
55: {
56:   /* TX uses the CPU1-owned channel 1 registers, while the destination FIFO
57:    * full state is reported by the destination channel (CPU0 is channel 0). */
58:   if (destination > 2 || data == NULL ||
59:       (getreg32(destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS : MBOX_CH1_STATUS) & 1u) != 0)
60:     {
61:       return -EAGAIN;
62:     }
63: 
64:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
65:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
66:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
67:   return OK;
68: }
69: 
70: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
71: {
72:   bk7258_mbox_message_t message;
73:   (void)irq;
74:   (void)context;
75:   (void)arg;
76: 
77:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
78:     {
79:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&message) != OK)
80:         {
81:           break;
82:         }
83:       if (g_callback != NULL)
84:         {
85:           g_callback(&message);
86:         }
87:     }
88:   return OK;
89: }
90: 
91: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
92: {
93:   g_callback = callback;
94: }
95: 
96: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
97: {
98:   int ret;
99: 
100:   g_mbox_ready = false;
101:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1: FIFO starts at 2 and has three entries. */
102:   /* Channel 1 owns FIFO entries 2..4.  The start and length fields live in
103:    * separate registers on mailbox v2. */
104:   putreg32(2u | (1u << 8), MBOX_CH1_CFG);
105:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
106:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
107:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
108:   if (ret < 0)
109:     {
110:       return ret;
111:     }
112:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
113:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
114:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
115:     {
116:       bk7258_mbox_message_t ignored;
117:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&ignored) != OK)
118:         {
119:           break;
120:         }
121:     }
122: 
123:   g_mbox_ready = true;
124:   return OK;
125: }

423: 	s_uart[id].id_sw_fifo_enable_bits |= BIT(id);

429: #if CONFIG_UART_TX_DMA

资源划分

203:

当前的内存划分为: 每个core内有16KB的ITCM和16KB DTCM空间, sram/psram以及flash空间是AP和CP共享的。

当前的SDK中已经按照资源的需求划分好了CP与AP的内存。

222:

架构采用的是全复位方案, 即CP或AP系统出现异常时, 整个系统全部复位。

由于看门狗硬件资源只有一份, 所以将其放在了CP上进行管理。由以下的宏进行配置:

CONFIG_INT_WDT=y
229: CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS=8000
230: CONFIG_TASK_WDT=y
231: CONFIG_TASK_WDT_PERIOD_MS=16000

239:

AP侧在启动后, 会定时向CP发送心跳包(默认间隔时间为2S)。该功能由宏CONFIG_SLAVE_HEART_BEAT控制, 默认开启。

当CP侧超过一定时间(与配置的INT WDT超时时间一致)没有接收到AP侧的心跳包, 则认为AP侧异常掉线, 会触发系统重启。

131:

[English]

132:

本文档主要介绍Armino平台BK7258多CPU log机制

133:
134:
    135:

  • BK7258 CP的log默认通过串口DL_UART0输出(默认波特率为115200)，输出uart端口可在CP侧config文件中使用 CONFIG_UART_PRINT_PORT 配置。

    • 136:

  • BK7258 AP的log通过mailbox转发到CP，并通过CP侧的log串口输出。

    • 137:

  • AP log带apx标签（异常log除外），AP中的cpu1带有log标签ap0，cpu2带有log标签ap1，而CP log不带有表示cpu的标签。

    • 138:

  • Armino平台默认采用异步Log输出机制，缓存缓存分为静态缓存和动态缓存，输出Log时优先使用静态缓存，当静态缓存不足时，使用动态缓存。

    • 139:

  • 当静态缓存和动态缓存均耗尽时，采用阻塞机制，若处于不可阻塞状态下，缓存耗尽时，将使Log直接输出至串口，此时Log带有前缀”INSRT:”，此Log会插入在其他Log中间，并影响此Log输出时序。

    • 140:

  • 通过串口输入log命令查看当前log配置

    • 141:

  • log 1 3 0 命令第一个参数为echo开关 (0/1)，第二个参数为log级别(0~5)，第三个参数为同步开关(0异步,1同步)

    • 142:
143:

备注

146:

当Log中带有前缀”INSRT:”前缀时，表示buffer缓存耗尽，直接从log设备输出log，并且可能会打断其他log，并造成这一条log顺序出错。 147: 如果经常出现这样的情况，建议增加buffer静态缓存或动态缓存。 148: 通过关闭 CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG 宏或使用log cli命令均可切换至同步log，同步log不使用缓存机制，直接将log内容输出到串口。 149: 因此可能造成中断或临界区执行时间过长，影响实时调度，因此强烈不建议在非调试环境下使用同步log。

180: ### 2、串口
181: 
182: #### 概述
183: 
184: 芯片通常包含多路串口，通常选用一路串口作为系统控制台（console），用于输出日志和 `nsh` 交互。在系统初始化（bringup）过程中，这一路串口的正常工作非常关键，详情请参见[串口驱动适配](../device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/UART/UART.md)。
185: 
186: #### 代码位置
187: 
188: - 参考实现：
189:     - [stm32_serial.c](https://github.com/open-vela/nuttx/blob/41545a4ca98165813908e5fe25d3ecdbfc5ab19a/arch/arm/src/stm32f7/stm32_serial.c)
190:     - [stm32_lowputc.c](https://github.com/open-vela/nuttx/blob/41545a4ca98165813908e5fe25d3ecdbfc5ab19a/arch/arm/src/stm32f7/stm32_lowputc.c)
191: 
192: - 串口相关实现一般位于：
193: 
194:     - `<vendor_name>_lowputc.c`
195:     - `<vendor_name>_serial.c`
196: 
197: #### 初始化流程
198: 
199: - 串口的初始化通常发生在 `nx_start` 之前。
200: 
201: - 每个架构（arch）都会提供 `<arch>_earlyserialinit` 接口，用于初始化控制台对应的串口寄存器，后续可通过 `<arch>_lowputc` 函数完成日志打印。下面是 ARM 平台的示例函数：
202: 
203:     ```C
204: 
205:     ./arm/src/common/arm_internal.h
206: 
207:     /****************************************************************************
208:     - Name: arm_earlyserialinit
209:     -
210:     - Description:
211:     - Performs the low level USART initialization early in debug so that the
212:     - serial console will be available during bootup.  This must be called
213:     - before arm_serialinit.
214:     -
215:      ****************************************************************************/
216: 
217:     #ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
218:     void arm_earlyserialinit(void)
219:     {
220:     }
221: 
222:     /****************************************************************************
223:     - Name: arm_lowputc
224:     -
225:     - Description:
226:     - Output one byte on the serial console
227:     -
228:      ****************************************************************************/
229: 
230:     void arm_lowputc(char ch)
231:     {
232:     }
233: 
234:     ```
235: 
236: #### 串口访问
237: 
238: 操作系统代码会使用通用架构接口 `up_putc` 和 `up_puts` 来直接访问串口，其中 `up_putc` 需要厂商实现。
239: 
240: ```C
241: /****************************************************************************
242:  * Name: up_putc
243:  *
244:  * Description:
245:  *   Provide priority, low-level access to support OS debug writes
246:  *
247:  ****************************************************************************/
248: 
249: void up_putc(int ch)
250: {
251: }
252: ```
253: 
254: #### 串口驱动注册
255: 
256: 为了使应用可以通过标准输入/输出（`stdin/out/err`）访问物理串口，必须注册串口驱动。
257: 
258: - 每个架构提供 `<arm>_serialinit` 接口，由厂商实现。
259: 
260: - 内部调用 `uart_register` 注册控制台和其他串口设备节点。以下为 ARM 平台示例：
261: 
262:     ```C
263: 
264:     /****************************************************************************
265:     - Name: arm_serialinit
266:     -
267:     - Description:
268:     - Register serial console and serial ports.  This assumes
269:     - that arm_earlyserialinit was called previously.
270:     -
271:      ****************************************************************************/
272: 
273:     void arm_serialinit(void)
274:     {
275:         #ifdef CONSOLE_DEV
276:         uart_register("/dev/console", &CONSOLE_DEV);
277:         #endif
278:         ...
279:     }
280:     ```

text:
**结论**
1. 当前 `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` 实现确实只有 `AP -> CP -> PC`：
   - 初始化并监听 `MB_UART0`：[driver.c:124](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:124)
   - 从 Mailbox UART 读取 AP 数据：[driver.c:110](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:110)
   - 加 `ap0: ` 前缀后交给 CP shell 日志队列：[driver.c:56](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:56)
   - 文件内没有 `bk_mb_uart_write()`，也没有物理 UART0 RX 转发逻辑。
2. OpenVela AP 当前同样是明确的 output-only：
   - Mailbox 收到 CP 的 `MB_CHNL_UART0_RX` 后只回 ACK、丢弃数据：[bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:446](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:446)
   - NuttX serial `receive()` 固定返回 `-1`：[bk7258_serial.c:48](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_serial.c:48)
   - `rxavailable()` 固定返回 `false`：[bk7258_serial.c:58](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_serial.c:58)
3. 因而仅在 CP 增加 `bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, ...)` 不够；CP 输入路由和 AP NuttX serial RX 两端都必须补齐。

**当前输出链路**
`NuttX stdout/syslog -> bk7258_mbox_uart_write -> AP逻辑通道0x19 -> CP逻辑通道0x49/MB_UART0 RX -> ap_uart0_log_task -> shell_log_raw_data -> CP UART0 GPIO10/11 -> PC`

通道号匹配正确：AP 侧 `MB_CHNL_UART0_TX=0x19`、接收 CP 为 `0x49`，[bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:21](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:21)；原厂枚举中 CP/AP 的 `MB_CHNL_UART0` 分别位于对应源/目的 CPU 编码下，[CP mailbox_channel.h:64](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:64)、[AP mailbox_channel.h:75](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:75)。

当前 OpenVela 虽将设备命名为 UART1，但没有占用物理 UART1：`bk7258_uart1_configure()` 明确不做 pinmux，[bk7258_lowputc.c:18](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_lowputc.c:18)；`/dev/console` 和 `/dev/ttyS1` 实际绑定的是 Mailbox UART，[bk7258_serial.c:131](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_serial.c:131)。

**原厂已有机制**
原厂确实已有 shell log/command forwarding，但使用另一套 `MB_CHNL_LOG` 协议，不是 `MB_UART0` 字节流：

- CP 非 SMP 构建自动启用 `FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX` 和 `RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX`：[shell_task.c:37](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:37)
- `ap_cmd ...` 将完整命令封装为 `MB_CMD_USER_INPUT`：[cli_main.c:1198](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c:1198)、[shell_task.c:2411](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:2411)
- 原厂 AP Armino shell 在 `MB_CHNL_LOG` 上接收该命令：[shell_mailbox_cp1.c:144](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_cli/shell_mailbox_cp1.c:144)
- AP Armino 日志通过 `MB_CMD_LOG_OUT` 返回 CP：[shell_mailbox_cp1.c:199](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_cli/shell_mailbox_cp1.c:199)
- CP 将收到的 AP 日志重新排入物理 UART shell 输出：[shell_task.c:2335](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:2335)

官方本地网页也明确说明 AP 日志经 Mailbox 到 CP UART0，并带 `ap0/ap1` 标签：[系统日志:135](/home/mi/vela_competition/博通网页文档/系统日志%20—%20博通集成%20ARMINO%20IDK%20AP%20开发框架%20文档.html:135)、[架构文档:244](/home/mi/vela_competition/博通网页文档/AP(SMP)+CP%20架构%20—%20博通集成%20ARMINO%20SMP开发框架%20文档.html:244)。

这套原厂 shell forwarding 可借鉴 ACK、缓存和日志汇聚，但不能直接给 NSH 使用：它按完整 Armino CLI 命令转发，不支持 readline、退格、Ctrl-C 等逐字节 TTY 语义；当前 NuttX 也没有实现 `MB_CHNL_LOG/MB_CMD_USER_INPUT`。

**推荐双向实现**
CP 侧应扩展现有 `MB_UART0` 服务，而不是再打开一个通道：

1. 保留 `driver.c` 中唯一一次 `bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0)`；`mb_chnl_open()` 会拒绝同一逻辑通道的第二个 owner，[mailbox_channel.c:794](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:794)。
2. 在现有桥服务中增加 TX 队列，并注册 `bk_mb_uart_register_tx_isr()`；根据 `bk_mb_uart_write_ready()` 循环调用 `bk_mb_uart_write()`，正确处理部分写入。API 定义见 [mb_uart_driver.h:81](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h:81)、[mb_uart_driver.h:98](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h:98)、[mb_uart_driver.h:126](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h:126)。
3. 不要在 `driver.c` 另注册物理 UART0 RX ISR。UART 驱动每端口只有一个回调槽，后注册会覆盖 shell：[uart_driver.c:1296](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/uart/uart_driver.c:1296)；现有 shell 已在 [shell_uart.c:344](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_uart.c:344) 占用该槽并关闭软件 FIFO。
4. 最合适的路由点是 CP shell 任务的 `rx_ind_process()`：[shell_task.c:1177](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:1177)。增加显式 `CP CLI / AP console` 模式；AP 模式下读取现有 shell UART 缓冲，但跳过 `handle_shell_input()`，将原始字节送入桥 TX 队列。
5. 保留一个不转发的本地退出转义序列，禁止简单广播给 CP CLI 和 AP NSH。`ap_cmd help` 可作为临时整行方案，但不构成完整交互控制台。
6. AP 侧为 `MB_CHNL_UART0_RX` 增加 RX 环形缓冲；处理 `MB_UART_SEND_DATA/STATE`、RTS 和 `uart_tx_fail`，然后让 serial 层的 `rxavailable()` 查询缓冲、`receive()` 弹出字节、`rxint()`维护启用状态，并在数据到达时调用 `uart_recvchars()`。NuttX 上半部所需契约见 [serial_io.c:128](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/serial/serial_io.c:128)。
7. AP 必须校验 `param1/param2`：CP 的交换区是 `0x2809f800..0x280a0000`，[app.map:52610](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/bk7258/app/bk7258/app.map:52610)；长度不得超过 `MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN=128`，[mb_chnl_buff.h:28](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mb_chnl_buff.h:28)。当前代码只校验命令封套位于 CP RAM，[bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:323](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:323)，不能据此信任 payload 指针。

**初始化顺序**
CP 当前顺序基本合理：GPIO和 ATE 检测先于 UART，[driver.c:410](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:410)；`bk_uart_driver_init()` 又通过 `bk_printf_init()` 实际初始化 UART0 为 115200 8N1，[printf_base.c:46](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_system/printf_base.c:46)；随后 `ipc_init()`、`MB_UART0`、`mb_ipc_init()`，[driver.c:452](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:452)；CP CLI 更晚在 `bk_init()` 中启动，[bk_init.c:331](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_init/bk_init.c:331)。

AP 当前先在 `nx_start()` 前建立早期 syslog 缓冲，[bk7258_start.c:125](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:125)，之后注册 `/dev/console`，Mailbox 硬件和 PWC 在 board late 阶段启动，[bk7258_bringup.c:34](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c:34)。应在发送 AP ready 前保证 Mailbox RX 环、serial RX 和 `uart_recvchars()` 路径均已可用；CP 只在该 ready 后允许切入 AP console 模式。

**主要风险**
- 当前输出按行加前缀且无换行时延迟 50 ms，[driver.c:99](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:99)。用于日志合适，用于 NSH prompt 会有明显延迟；AP console 模式应即时 raw 输出并考虑禁用前缀。
- CP 日志和 AP NSH 共用一个物理 TX，日志可能插入命令回显。若要求可靠交互，AP console 模式需限制 CP 异步日志，或至少分别标记并序列化。
- UART0 同时是下载口、CP shell、默认 AT 口：配置见 [CP config:92](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:92)、[CP config:215](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:215)、[CP config:731](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:731)。桥只能在运行期显式接管，不能影响 bootloader/BKFIL 和 ATE 检测。
- 物理 UART0 没有硬件流控，Mailbox 内部虽有 RTS/CTS，但高速粘贴仍可能耗尽 CP shell 200 字节缓冲和 MB UART FIFO。
- 原厂 `mb_uart_init()` 的空指针检查重复检查了 `tx_xchg_buff`，漏检 `rx_xchg_buff`：[mb_uart_driver.c:440](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:440)。
- 当前 `s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail` 只计数、不暴露；AP TX 满时 NuttX syslog 也无条件报告写入成功，[bk7258_syslog.c:26](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_syslog.c:26)，两端都需要可查询的丢包统计。
- `driver.c` 的桥是相对原始版本新增的已提交改动，并非当前未暂存差异；原始 `bk_idk` 的 `driver.c` 没有此桥，[bk_idk driver.c:341](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:341)。
